description: Contract for the Fergents kernel JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol over the local socket. Source of truth for Rust and TypeScript codegen.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: A kernel event emitted on the bus (ARCHITECTURE.md §4.2).

source.description: Who emitted the event, e.g. agent:ferg-01.

correlation_id.description: Groups events in one logical operation.

HelloParams.title: HelloParams
HelloParams.description: First command sent by a client after connecting.

WelcomeResult.title: WelcomeResult
WelcomeResult.description: Kernel reply to hello when the client version is compatible.

PingResult.title: PingResult
PingResult.description: Liveness probe reply; carries no diagnostics.

topics.description: Topic prefixes, e.g. kernel. or file.changed.

from_id.description: Deliver events strictly after this id.

BrainListParams.title: BrainListParams
BrainListParams.description: Params of brain.list. `brain.list` is extended in Phase 1 with an archived filter.

BrainRole.title: BrainRole
BrainRole.description: A brain's role within a project (BRAIN.md §8.1).

template.description: Template name, e.g. blank, personal, research, coding, team (BRAIN.md §7.1).

path.description: Filesystem path for the new brain.

BrainGetResult.title: BrainGetResult
BrainGetResult.description: Result of brain.get: the brain summary, its lifecycle state, and its brain.toml config (BRAIN.md §6.1).

BrainUpdateParams.title: BrainUpdateParams
BrainUpdateParams.description: Params of brain.update: mutable identity fields (BRAIN.md §6.1 [brain]).

rewrite_links.description: Rewrite internal links to the new brain id (BRAIN.md §8.5).

BrainMoveParams.title: BrainMoveParams
BrainMoveParams.description: Params of brain.move: relocate a brain folder (BRAIN.md §10.1).

confirm_name.description: The brain name, typed to confirm deletion (BRAIN.md §9.6).

permanent.description: Delete permanently instead of moving to trash (BRAIN.md §9.6).

output.description: Path of the .fergbrain archive to write.

include_index.description: Include index.sqlite and graph.db (excluded by default; BRAIN.md §14.1).

path.description: Path of the .fergbrain archive to import.

target_path.description: Filesystem path to extract the brain into.

full.description: Force a full reindex instead of an incremental one.

exclude_private.description: Exclude personal data from the template (BRAIN.md §7.2).

SyncConfig.title: SyncConfig
SyncConfig.description: The [sync] section of brain.toml. Parsed and preserved only in Phase 1 (no runtime effect).

GitConfig.title: GitConfig
GitConfig.description: The [git] section of brain.toml. Parsed and preserved only in Phase 1 (no runtime effect).

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A row of the documents table (spec Appendix B).

frontmatter.description: Raw YAML frontmatter as JSON (single source of truth).

deleted_at.description: Set when the document is soft-deleted.

NoteRef.title: NoteRef
NoteRef.description: A lightweight reference to a note.

LinkRef.title: LinkRef
LinkRef.description: A row of the links table (spec Appendix B).

unresolved.description: True when the target does not exist yet.

OutlineEntry.title: OutlineEntry
OutlineEntry.description: A heading in a note's outline, in document order (BRAIN.md §4.2). The tree is derived from `level`.

UnlinkedMention.title: UnlinkedMention
UnlinkedMention.description: A place where a note's title appears as plain text, not a link (GRAPH.md §7.3).

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: A row of the tags table (spec Appendix B).

IndexStatusResult.title: IndexStatusResult
IndexStatusResult.description: Index status: the persisted, observable job queue (SEARCH.md §13.2, §13.4; spec Appendix B index_jobs).

queued.description: Jobs waiting in the persisted queue.

attempts.description: Total retry attempts across queued/running jobs (index_jobs.attempts).

path.description: Vault-relative path of the new note.

DocDeleteParams.title: DocDeleteParams
DocDeleteParams.description: Params of doc.delete (soft delete; spec Task 8.4).

DocOutlineResult.title: DocOutlineResult
DocOutlineResult.description: The heading outline of a note, in document order (levels imply nesting).

LinksBrokenResult.title: LinksBrokenResult
LinksBrokenResult.description: Links whose target is unresolved (spec Appendix B, links.unresolved).

DailyOpenResult.title: DailyOpenResult
DailyOpenResult.description: The daily note, created on first open of the day (BRAIN.md §4.4).

created.description: True when the note was created by this call.

TemplateRenderParams.title: TemplateRenderParams
TemplateRenderParams.description: Params of template.render. Variables from BRAIN.md §4.5 (date/time/datetime are computed; title/selection/clipboard are provided).

language.description: Query language; the doc example uses datalog.

GraphQueryResult.title: GraphQueryResult
GraphQueryResult.description: Rows returned by a graph query (columns depend on the query).

GraphAlgoParams.title: GraphAlgoParams
GraphAlgoParams.description: Params of graph.algo (GRAPH.md §10.3). Algorithms: shortest_path, neighbors, centrality, pagerank, communities, similarity, cycles, subgraph (§10.1).

GraphAlgoResult.title: GraphAlgoResult
GraphAlgoResult.description: Rows returned by a graph algorithm (shape depends on the algorithm).

target_id.description: Canonical entity kept after the merge.
